keys.about.title: Who We Are
keys.about.mission: a global alliance 🫱‍🫲 committed to promoting peace🕊and understanding.🕯️ We believe faith should unite 🔗, not divide, and we work through dialogue 💬, education, and shared action 🤍
keys.updates.title: Follow Our Latest Updates
keys.dd.title: Divine Digital
keys.dd.quote: The Digital Bridge to Spiritual Eternity
keys.dd.description: We bring faith closer, more modern, and more accessible by creating a digital ecosystem for temples, mosques, churches, spiritual centres, and religious organizations around the world — across more than 14 religions.
keys.dd.service1: Creation of modern, stylish, and informative websites and brand design for religious organizations
keys.dd.service3: Support for religious organizations in managing social media
keys.em.title: Eternal Map
keys.em.description: We are creating technology that helps people easily find those who are no longer with us and show care for those who forever remain in their hearts, no matter the distance.
keys.em.service1: Cemetery navigation systems allow loved ones to be located via an app or a navigation display
keys.em.service2: Flower delivery and grave cleaning services are now more accessible, wherever we may be
keys.foh.title: Faith Of Harmony
keys.foh.description: We are creating a new format for interfaith dialogue—through music, emotion, and creativity.
keys.foh.service1: Faith in Harmony is a cultural platform where each faith can express itself through music
keys.foh.service2: International spiritual music label UWRO Music
keys.foh.service3: Launch of an FM wave across the globe
keys.foh.service4: Organization of faith festivals featuring representatives of different religions and traditions
keys.dds.title: Divine Donor Status
keys.dds.introTitle: Unlock Your Divine Rank Through Giving
keys.dds.introDesc1: At UWRO, your donation isn't just support — it's a sacred act that helps build unity across faiths, create digital sanctuaries, and light the way for spiritual growth around the world.
keys.dds.introDesc2: As you give, you rise through our Divine Donor Ranks — each one marking your generosity and your impact. Every rank comes with its own blessings, recognition, and spiritual rewards.
keys.dds.howDesc1: The more you give, the more light you shine. From $10 to $1,000,000+, each donation unlocks a new status — from humble Light Bearer to legendary Eternal Founder.
keys.dds.howDesc2: Along the way, you'll receive gifts like exclusive access to the Praymory App, digital memorials, VIP invites, and eternal gratitude (literally).

keys.pres.quote1: We are making a meaningful contribution to the religious world in the era of global digitalization. From now on, faith and religion will embody the highest standards of technology and art.
keys.pres.quote2: We do not change faith—we strengthen it and make it accessible to everyone.
